essence: The verse invokes the armor mantra for total, all-around protection of the practitioner.
Oblation with clarified butter and its sprinkling yields a consecrated material for ritual use.
A specific marking diagram prepared there confers land as its benefit.
Recitation alone yields success, and oblations with ghee and milk-rice further support it.
The verse invokes the staff as a force that may impel or inspire us.
